version.changelog: v3.0.2: 修正cron ID和频率描述，全面检查并更新所有skill内容

llm.summary: This instruction-only skill is internally consistent with its stated purpose (extracting and persisting conversation 'memories') and requests only the file- and session-accesses you'd expect for that task.

dimensions.detail: The name/description (extract memories at the end of a conversation) align with the instructions: read recent session messages, detect end-of-conversation, and write topic files under memory/topics/ and update MEMORY.md. No unrelated credentials, binaries, or installs are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Instructions explicitly require reading session history and writing files in memory/, and define formats and triggers (auto on end-of-dialog, heartbeat, manual command). This is appropriate for a memory-extraction skill, but it does grant the agent access to full recent conversation content and to persist it—so sensitive content may be stored unless the agent enforces the listed 'What NOT to Save' rules and asks for confirmation when needed.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Instruction-only skill with no install spec and no code files — nothing is written to disk by an installer and there are no external downloads, so install risk is minimal.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables or external credentials are requested. The declared required permissions (FileRead/FileWrite/FileEdit and sessions_history) are proportional to extracting and persisting conversation memories, though they are powerful and should be granted only if you trust the skill.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request forced inclusion. Autonomous invocation is allowed (platform default) and the skill's heartbeat/auto-trigger behavior is documented; this is expected for a memory automator but increases the importance of careful permission scoping and retention policy.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears coherent with its purpose, but it will read recent messages and persist extracted content to memory/topics/ and MEMORY.md. Before installing: (1) Confirm you want an agent that can read and write conversation history; (2) Ensure the agent enforces the 'What NOT to Save' rules and prompts before saving potentially sensitive data (passwords, secrets, private links); (3) Prefer manual invocation if you are uncomfortable with automatic heartbeat or end-of-conversation triggers; (4) Review where memory/ is stored, set retention/cleanup policies, and test with non-sensitive conversations first. If you need further assurance, ask the skill author for specifics on filtering sensitive content and on how duplicates/append behavior are handled.
